summary.tldr: The meeting focused on the default retention of audio files after transcription, with opposing views on data privacy. Ultimately, no decision was made on a default retention policy, and a list of privacy tradeoffs will be reviewed at the next meeting.

participants.speaker: Speaker 1
said: I prefer keeping audio by default so people can check transcription errors.
I still prefer keeping audio.
I do not agree to deletion by default.

participants.speaker: Speaker 2
said: I disagree. Audio should be deleted after transcription to reduce retained sensitive data.
I still prefer deletion.
I will prepare a list of the privacy tradeoffs by Tuesday.

participants.speaker: You
said: Both arguments are on the table.
We will not settle the default today.
The only agreement is to review that list next time. There is no agreed audio retention default.
